# The Apex Accelerator

> Personalized university and scholarship application strategy for ambitious Canadian high school students in Grades 9–12. Based in Toronto, Ontario, serving students across Canada. Website: https://apexaccelerator.ca

Apex sells clarity first: a complete, written, personalized roadmap of everything a student needs to do, in order. Higher tiers add scoped coaching, accountability and application support. All prices are in CAD. Apex does not guarantee admission or scholarship outcomes.

## Packages

- Apex Strategy ($249 CAD): pre-session intake questionnaire; 2-hour 1-on-1 strategy session; full profile review; reach / match / safe university and program list; a written Apex Roadmap within 3 business days (habits to fix, the goal to build around, how to land research, an internship or a passion project, and a weekly schedule); scholarship shortlist; Apex resource library; one 30-minute follow-up call within 60 days.
- Apex Momentum ($1,199 CAD or 3 × $400, recommended, best for Grades 9–11 building their profile): everything in Strategy plus 3 months of coaching: six 45-minute sessions every two weeks, milestone tracking, message support between sessions, passion project guidance, networking guidance to help students connect with university students, researchers and industry professionals, and an updated roadmap at the end.
- Apex Advantage ($2,999 CAD or 6 × $500, best for Grades 11–12 heading into applications): everything in Momentum extended to 6 months (12 coaching sessions), plus a final school list with a strategy for each, essay and supplementary application editing, scholarship application support, mock interview prep, and ongoing support through application season.
- Application support add-ons for Strategy or Momentum: university application support $449; scholarship application support $549; complete application bundle $849 (save $149), or $1,098 with Strategy and $2,048 with Momentum. Ongoing Discord community support is included with each application support option, whether purchased on its own or added to a package; add-ons do not include a consultation. Momentum and Advantage also include ongoing Discord community support. Package add-ons must be purchased within 30 days of the initial package purchase. Application support is included in Apex Advantage.
- Upgrade credit: Start with Strategy. If you upgrade within 30 days, your $249 is credited in full.
